title: Complete authorized integration or hand off
purpose: Finish any already-authorized safe integration first; otherwise produce a compact continuation record that lets the receiver re-enter without trusting stale chat memory.
inputs: merge authority and source when already granted
steps: Refresh branch, HEAD, PR, checks/reviews, mergeability, and dirty-state evidence.
List files changed and validators actually run with exits.
Name generated artifact paths and state that they are local/untracked.
State what is verified, what remains unproved, and the exact blocker if any.

If validated in-scope merge authority is already granted by the current task or a standing repository-owner directive, record that authority source, keep the exact-head guard, and make the current harness agent the merge owner.
Execute an already-authorized safe merge before final handoff; opening a PR or printing a merge command is not completion while that action remains executable.

If merge authority or another real dependency is unresolved, provide one copy-paste next command that resolves repository location safely, verifies the exact remote ref/SHA, preserves dirty work using an isolated worktree, runs the owning validator, resolves the canonical operator artifact, and propagates nonzero exits.
Require the receiver to re-inspect current state before any later mutation.
outputs: GitHub merge proof when integration authority was already granted and merge succeeds
proofCeiling: Continuation/integration metadata and exact GitHub merge result only; never runtime, deployment, provider, or live-target authority by itself.
